methodology: Historical web research only; no SerpApi quota consumed. For each exact tracked SKU, use the lowest defensible dated US retail observation found in August 2025. Market/MSRP references may be retained for context but are not eligible to trigger BUY NOW. When an exact SKU was not selected or a defensible dated retail price could not be found, no price is invented.

cpu.note: Lowest verified August 2025 Newegg retail observation found in the historical record.

motherboard.note: Lowest verified August 2025 Newegg observation found; repeated on Aug 25 and Aug 29.

gpu-5090.note: August 2025 contemporaneous MSRP reference. Not an exact retailer sale and not eligible to trigger BUY NOW.

nvme-4tb-samsung-990pro.note: Exact 4TB family in approved storage pool.
